summary: This dataset aims to investigate the relationship between cone loss and its impact on specific visual circuits and behavior in the retina. To achieve this, researchers will examine the effects of varying degrees of cone loss on a visual reflex, specifically the optokinetic reflex, and the underlying population of ganglion cells critical to that behavior. The study will utilize single-cell retinal physiology and computational models to identify circuit mechanisms that determine the vulnerability of specific ganglion cell types to partial cone loss.
